source: GSTN / Ministry of Finance, Government of India — GST Revenue Report for October 2026 (published 2026-11-01).
notes: October 2026 total gross GST revenue (comparable ex-cess series) was ₹231,290 crore, 22.9% above the ₹188,125 crore comparable October 2025 base. The October 2025 headline PIB growth of 4.6% included cess and is not definitionally identical, so it is not used as the prior-year field. Figures are provisional. Source: https://tutorial.gst.gov.in/downloads/news/gst_revenue_report_final_for_publishing_oct_2026.pdf ; cross-check: https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2185839

unavailable.prior_year_growth_pct: No definitionally identical prior-year comparable in the retrieved official October 2026 report.
unavailable.collections_usd: GSTN publishes collections in INR; no official USD conversion is published for this series.
